_about: kituafund.com — site overrides on top of fonterra-shared-block-mapping.json (evidence: dump-variants + review-sheet.jpg). Note: 14 of the 30 sitemap URLs are team/board 'pages' that 301 straight to LinkedIn profiles.

related-articles.rationale: Query-driven article rail (minimal-card, 'Related Articles' on news pages) and the 'Our Team' masonry grid with LinkedIn icons on the home page (data-slidetype/perpage, prev/next buttons). Cards come from tagged pages at runtime — query-index driven custom block with two variants.

card.rationale: Partner/team card (logo or photo, name, copy, 'Read more') placed in carousel/panel containers (13 instances on Partners/Team) → Cards; the partner grid is filtered by card-filter-panel.
